title: KCS U1c RUN: the two-process zeta/sieve residual harness at the common edge — both processes on the same input chi at the same x; the sieve side is EXACT (Phi remainders vs xV(31) = 11.5/19.8/12.2/0.514 at x = 1e4/1e5/1e6/1e7, consistent with 0181; the chi-3/chi-5 variants bounded exact integers, measured range {-9,...,11}, consistent with U1a's boundedness); the zeta side is the C-channel E7a action identity (day006 harness form) at s = 1/2 + it, t in {10,100}, x <= 1e6, dps 30, floor residual R_z in [0, 5.3e-30]. Baseline finding: the dps sweep at one edge shows R_z tracking the precision exactly (1.09e-11 at dps 10 -> 6.68e-52 at dps 50, i.e. O(10^-dps)) — the zeta-side IDENTITY residual is pure roundoff, not a dynamical quantity, while the sieve-side residual is exact structure (O(1)..O(20) vs xV) — so the simplest turn-taking reading of the two identity residuals is ruled out at this level; O1's corrected next step names a measured zeta-side datum (E1/S-series type) as the zeta component. Raw ratio log = the O1 input. 58 s wall.
claim: No RH claim: the zeta-side residual is the finite-dps residual of the EXACT E7a action identity (the same identity the day006 harness verified at dps 50; here re-measured at x <= 1e6 on the critical line s = 1/2 + it), and the sieve side is exact integer arithmetic (the 0180/0183 machinery, U1a's character form V_chi(x,z) = sum_{d|P} mu(d) chi(d) S_chi(floor(x/d)) at z = 31, P squarefree, 2^11 = 2048 divisors enumerated exactly; the character prefix sums use the exact O(1) period shortcut). What is measured (plan U1 item (c), gate 'floor residual (c)'): (1) the exact sieve table at z = 31 for all four x and three characters, including the exact remainders vs the main term x*V(31) for the trivial character — 11.52151 (1e4), 19.78486 (1e5), 12.15139 (1e6), 0.5138899 (1e7) — agreeing in scale and shape with the 0181 first-order width table (V(31) = 0.152852... exactly; 1e7*V(31) - 1528521 = 0.5138899); (2) the residual pairs at the common edge (x, chi, t) with the relative floor R_z/|C| — R_z <= 5.3e-30 at dps 30, relative <= 5.3e-30, three rows exactly 0.0 (the identity holds at the displayed precision); (3) the dps-floor law: R_z = 1.09e-11 (dps 10), 1.11e-16 (15), 8.47e-22 (20), 9.86e-32 (30), 1.62e-41 (40), 6.68e-52 (50) at (x, t, chi) = (1e5, 10, (./5)) — a precision-law, not a structural floor. Honest reading (recorded, not claimed): the two processes' residuals live at radically different scales because the zeta-side quantity is an IDENTITY (residual = roundoff) while the sieve-side is a COUNT (residual = structure); the orbital side-quest's simplest turn-between-read is therefore ruled out at this level, and O1 (the orbital reading of U1c) is narrowed to cross-correlating the EXACT sieve residual at (x, z) with a MEASURED zeta-side datum — an E1/S-series-type residual, i.e. the mainstream's own measured residual — not an identity residual. The raw two-column log is written out as the O1 input record. Cost: 58 s wall, one core.
